body:
In mid July 2010 I was invited to a small music festival for a weekend. It was my first music festival so I decided I wasn't going to take it easy. Anyway, at the festival there was a tent selling legal highs, foolishly I requested the strongest thing youve got. I was promptly handed a whole cap of dried fly agaric, told not to bother eating it and asked for £5 of my money.
I tried to roll a 'joint' of the mushroom (which I had since ground up) but it failed so I sought something to mix it with. Luckily my friends were having no luck with some very expensive Kola nut powder so I mixed it and rolled it, boy did it do the trick.
Henceforth everything was just right, I floated around the festival like a cloud and more than once was trapped by the laser show. The only negative effects I felt were when it was wearing of, this made me incredibly angry, enough to pound the ground for a while.
All in all, a good experience for my first taste of a truly altered mind and great value!
